name: Create a Revit family to our standards

jobStory.when: someone in the company needs a Revit family, or a client asks us to model families to their standards
jobStory.iWantTo: prompt for it and get a family built as close to our (or the client's) standards as possible
jobStory.soICan: model faster and stay aligned to the standards without checking every family by hand

outcomes.statement: Reduce the chance a family leaves without the owner's identity parameters
Reduce the chance a parameter is named or grouped off-standard
Reduce the chance a nested component is rebuilt instead of taken from the approved library
Reduce the chance a nested family is shared when it doesn't need to be scheduled
Reduce the time from request to a family that flexes correctly

mustNotGoWrong: A client receives families that don't follow their standards
A family breaks when it flexes in a project

steps.title: Say what family is needed
steps.does: Category, hosting, sizes, types, whose standards

steps.title: Find the standards, template and library parts

tasks.text: Resolve the pack stack (base → client → project) for the request
Pick the family template for the category
Which library family to nest, when more than one fits

steps.title: Set up reference planes and parameters

jobMap.gap: No check before geometry is built that the setup matches the standard

steps.title: Build geometry, nest components, add types

jobMap.gap: How review comments on a family are fed back is not described

review.quick: The family author opens the family, flexes it and marks each finding accepted, changed or rejected.
review.deep: First five generated families, and before any family is generated without a person building it.
